subject: Post-discovery: ML/Infra deep dive — schedule, roster & prep
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily@avasolutions.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: ML/Infra deep dive — schedule, roster & prep

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great conversation and clear alignment on the primary success criteria (latency under 200ms p95 for the main inference path, deterministic KV cache behavior, and test dataset access). To keep momentum, we'd like to schedule the follow-up technical deep dive (60–90 minutes) with our ML infra and ops engineers.

Suggested agenda (60–90m):
- 5m: quick goals recap and success metrics
- 15m: your production traffic profile & sample flow (you)
- 25m: Redwood runtime architecture + quantization/throughput options (ML/infra)
- 20m: live walkthrough of a short inference trace (with sample payload)
- 10m: open Q&A and next steps / mutual action plan

Can you confirm the attendee list on your side (names + roles)? For us I'd propose: Ben (Infra lead), Grace (Solutions engineer), and me.

Availability windows (all shown in UTC / local equivalents) — please pick any that work for your team and we’ll lock a calendar invite:
- Option A: Wed 18 Jun, 16:00–17:30 UTC (09:00–10:30 PT, 12:00–13:30 ET)
- Option B: Thu 19 Jun, 14:00–15:30 UTC (07:00–08:30 PT, 10:00–11:30 ET)
- Option C: Mon 23 Jun, 17:00–18:30 UTC (10:00–11:30 PT, 13:00–14:30 ET)

Pre-reqs we usually need to run a useful deep dive:
- Sample request/response traces (redacted) or a 1–2 minute representative payload set
- A point-of-contact who can answer product/traffic questions during the session
- (Optional) a read-only S3/HTTP endpoint we can pull a small sample from if you want a live trace

I attached a draft mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf) for transparency on deliverables and owners — we'll iterate after the session.

Thanks — if any of the windows are tight, we can adjust; otherwise let me know which option works and who will join from Ava.

— Camila
